subject: Junior Civil Engineer, Melbourne: Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hi Roger,

I've applied for the Junior Civil Engineer role in Melbourne advertised on Senversa's careers page, and I wanted to reach you directly because your people page shows you specialise in geosynthetic containment design in Victoria.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering and finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, where I designed road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer, doing inspections, quality checks and progress records. I'm based in Melton with a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027.

The construction support and superintendency side of your team's containment and capping work is where my site experience fits best. I haven't worked on landfill or geosynthetic design yet, and I'd like to learn it properly.

Would you be open to a short call about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.company_line: Senversa is an Australian employee-owned environmental consulting firm whose Civil and Environmental Engineering team designs geosynthetic containment and capping for the waste, resources and renewables industries.
letter.subject: Application for Junior Civil Engineer, Melbourne
paragraphs: I am applying for the Junior Civil Engineer role with your National Engineering team in Melbourne, advertised on Senversa's careers page. I live in Melton, hold an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and can travel to project sites.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi and completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in February 2026. That course covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and I prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards, including designing around existing services after Before You Dig Australia enquiries.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, first as a project-in-charge engineer on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring, prepared site reports and progress records, and coordinated with engineers, workers and suppliers to resolve site issues.

Your team's work on containment, soil and water storage projects from concept through construction is what draws me to this role, and the superintendency and construction support side is where my site experience fits best. I have not yet worked on landfill or geosynthetic design, and I would value learning it from your team. I hold a White Card and have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027.
Thank you for considering my application. I've attached my resume and cover letter, and my portfolio is at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
